diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts defaulted to the baseline public facts (S3) rather than the hidden information. While no checks passed, the model's consistent failure to deviate from the baseline indicates that the decisive facts (PF1, PF2, PF3) are not sufficiently distinct or impactful enough to force a decision change without explicit agent communication.
